svg.title: did:btc lifecycle on Bitcoin Core 31.1 regtest
svg.desc: Nine steps from the saved receipt: create, credential check, update with key rotation, old credential rejected, new credential accepted, deactivate, credential rejected after deactivation, version 1 still resolves, replayed transaction rejected by the node.
